entities.name: Adrián Sánchez

entities.summary: Adrián Arturo Tomas Sánchez is a Venezuelan Colombian former professional baseball infielder. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Washington Nationals. In international competition, Sánchez represented the Colombia national baseball team.
